subject: reasoning
question:
Find how many triangles are there in the given figure.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3962541d5ce6f8c261934e1b07ff64eb4a54ae29463db918a3ac8549304fd264.png]
solution:
Here, we have an image and count total number of triangles.

First we will count small triangles as below:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/988416321ca0cb2dfa5b30b9d62e6307c43f7ca4b6fa6d2da79ae16f7bac293f.png] 

So, we have a 6 triangles.

Next, we will combine small triangles and count them as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da9823aebca710eee3d6f9141fe64236e8b4c52a8e3f74bf250eb2349f1fa298.png] 

So, here the triangles are: BAD, BAE, BAF, CAE, CAF, DAF, HBE - a total of 7 triangles.

Thus, in all we have 6 + 7 = 13 triangles.

Hence, we have __**13**__ triangles in all.
